[workqueue] Fix running task count accounting. In the workqueue server, the number of running tasks was kept as a running count, and adjusted directly inside `ProcessRequests()`. Aborted tasks weren't accounted for, causing the count to slowly increase over time. This fixes things by moving the accounting to TaskManager. metrics: break upload of huge log into multiple passes When a brillo device loses connectivity, the metrics event log (also called "message file", containing the histogram samples etc.) keeps growing (I don't think this happens when Chrome is present, I believe Chrome is already dealing with these issues correctly). When connectivity is restored, the metrics daemon attempts to process the entire file at once and this can cause OOM panic. This change breaks the processing into multiple batches. Every time a batch is processed, the message file is modified to logically contain only the unprocessed messages. The daemon loops until all messages have been processed, then truncates the file to zero size (like before). Note that the issue of the message file growing indefinitely when connectivity is missing is not resolved by this CL. BUG=b:37579696 TEST=stop ui; stop metrics_daemon; metrics_daemon -uploader \ -upload_interval_secs=10; manually verify that large uma-events file gets sent piecewise.
